purpose: Teach: フェルナンド/クルス/ヴェルディ/サダム/リヨン/スコープ/アグリ/ドーン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スペインのフェルナンド王の歴史を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told you about King Ferdinand of Spain's history, didn't they?
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Gentle curiosity — noticing something Aoi mentioned. Warm half-smile in the voice. Slow, unhurried pace, like savoring a small detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペネロペ・クルスのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's a Penelope Cruz fan, apparently.
lines.style: Light, almost amused observation. Understated delivery — no emphasis, just noting it in passing. Brief pause before speaking, like remembering. Gentle warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヴェルディのオペラ「アイーダ」がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So they like Verdi's *Aida*, you said?
lines.style: Soft interest, checking in. Slight lift on the opera title — not dramatic, just respectful. Slower pace on *Aida*. The tone of someone filing away what matters to someone else.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、イラク戦争時のサダム・フセインのお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer was talking about Saddam Hussein during the Iraq War?
lines.style: Neutral, thoughtful tone — taking in information without judgment. Steady pacing. A slight breath before the historical reference, grounding it. Serious but not heavy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フランス第二の都市リヨンに行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They've been to Lyon, the second city in France, haven't they?
lines.style: Warm recognition — like fitting another piece into a picture. Slight emphasis on *second city*, curious about the detail. Unhurried, gentle pace. Affectionate interest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、双眼鏡のスコープ、つまり望遠スコープを愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They use telescope scopes — binoculars with those magnifying lenses — all the time, you said?
lines.style: Thoughtful clarification, explaining what they mean while keeping warmth. Slight pause after *scopes* to let the idea land. Patient tone, like understanding something specific about them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アグリ、つまり農業ベンチャーを応援されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They support agricultural ventures — you know, agri startups.
lines.style: Light, translating tone — making sense of the term without condescension. Brief, natural rhythm. Warm acknowledgment that this detail matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画「ドーン・オブ・ザ・デッド」がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they love the film *Dawn of the Dead*?
lines.style: Soft note of appreciation for the taste. Slight upturn on the film title — respecting their choice without irony. Warm, closing tone. Trailing-off slightly at the end, like tucking away one final detail.
